explanation: Hey Jude runs 7 minutes 11 seconds, about four of them its sing-along coda. Bohemian Rhapsody, famous as a long single, runs 5 minutes 55 seconds.

claims.text: The original 1968 release of 'Hey Jude' runs about 7 minutes 11 seconds.
The original 1975 release of 'Bohemian Rhapsody' runs about 5 minutes 55 seconds.
The sing-along coda of 'Hey Jude' lasts about four minutes.
'Bohemian Rhapsody' was regarded as unusually long for a single.
